why: issue 1974 — `void (*)(rcl_timer_t *, const rcl_timer_call_info_t *)`: the timer callback that receives Jazzy's call info. rcl hands the info out of `rcl_timer_call_with_info`, a dispatch call the user's own loop makes (`c:timer_call_with_info`, declined); here the executor dispatches, so the info rides on the callback. The info pointer is valid for the duration of the call. One producer: the executor's timer dispatcher (`arena::timer_call_info`, `nros_node::TimerCallInfo`) computes expected = actual - (elapsed - period) at the moment it decides the activation is due; C, C++ and Rust copy those two numbers, none computes its own. CORRECTED 2026-10-25 (phase-515 C1): the trailing `void *context` went with D2.
